product.description:
Upgrade your bathroom with the Futura Sage D-Shaped Soft Close Toilet Seat, made from durable premium thermoplastic for everyday use. Designed to fit most standard D-shaped toilet pans measuring 42.5cm x 36cm, it features adjustable hinges, top and bottom fixing options, a one-button quick release function and a soft close mechanism to help prevent slamming. Hygienic, easy to clean and ideal for adding a soft sage finish to your bathroom.

IMPORTANT – PLEASE CHECK YOUR TOILET DIMENSIONS BEFORE ORDERING

This D-shaped toilet seat measures approximately 425mm long × 360mm wide, with an internal seat opening of approximately 280mm long × 212mm wide.

The adjustable fittings are suitable for toilet pans with fixing holes positioned 60mm to 195mm apart, measured centre-to-centre.

To check compatibility, measure from the exact centre of one fixing hole in your toilet pan to the exact centre of the other fixing hole. Do not measure from the outside edges of the holes or from the existing hinge covers.

Required fixing hole spacing: 60–195mm centre-to-centre.

If your toilet fixing holes are less than 60mm or more than 195mm apart centre-to-centre, this seat will not be suitable.

Please check both the overall seat dimensions and fixing-hole spacing against your toilet before ordering.

product.description:

IMPORTANT – PLEASE CHECK YOUR TOILET DIMENSIONS BEFORE ORDERING

This oval toilet seat measures approximately 445mm long × 370mm wide, with an internal seat opening of approximately 287mm long × 235mm wide.

The adjustable fittings are suitable for toilet pans with fixing holes positioned 60mm to 195mm apart, measured centre-to-centre.

To check compatibility, measure from the exact centre of one fixing hole in your toilet pan to the exact centre of the other fixing hole. Do not measure from the outside edges of the holes or from the existing hinge covers.

Required fixing hole spacing: 60–195mm centre-to-centre.

If your toilet fixing holes are less than 60mm or more than 195mm apart centre-to-centre, this seat will not be suitable.

Please check both the overall seat dimensions and fixing-hole spacing against your toilet before ordering.

IMPORTANT – PLEASE CHECK YOUR TOILET DIMENSIONS BEFORE ORDERING

This oval toilet seat measures approximately 445mm long × 370mm wide, with an internal seat opening of approximately 287mm long × 235mm wide.

The adjustable fittings are suitable for toilet pans with fixing holes positioned 60mm to 195mm apart, measured centre-to-centre.

Required fixing hole spacing: 60–195mm centre-to-centre.

Please check both the overall seat dimensions and fixing-hole spacing against your toilet before ordering.

product.name: Futura Toilet Seat Soft Close Sage D Shape, Premium Thermoplastic, Quick Release, Easy Clean, Top & Bottom Fixings
product.description:
Upgrade your bathroom with the Futura Sage D-Shaped Soft Close Toilet Seat, made from durable premium thermoplastic for everyday use. Designed to fit most standard D-shaped toilet pans measuring 42.5cm x 36cm, it features adjustable hinges, top and bottom fixing options, a one-button quick release function and a soft close mechanism to help prevent slamming. Hygienic, easy to clean and ideal for adding a soft sage finish to your bathroom.

IMPORTANT – PLEASE CHECK YOUR TOILET DIMENSIONS BEFORE ORDERING

This D-shaped toilet seat measures approximately 425mm long × 360mm wide, with an internal seat opening of approximately 280mm long × 212mm wide.

The adjustable fittings are suitable for toilet pans with fixing holes positioned 60mm to 195mm apart, measured centre-to-centre.

To check compatibility, measure from the exact centre of one fixing hole in your toilet pan to the exact centre of the other fixing hole. Do not measure from the outside edges of the holes or from the existing hinge covers.

Required fixing hole spacing: 60–195mm centre-to-centre.

If your toilet fixing holes are less than 60mm or more than 195mm apart centre-to-centre, this seat will not be suitable.

Please check both the overall seat dimensions and fixing-hole spacing against your toilet before ordering.
